brief_en: No major official announcements, product ships, or model releases from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta AI, xAI or notable open-source players in the past 12 hours. Frontier labs remain quiet after early-August safety, leadership and product updates.
brief_zh: 過去12小時內，OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、Meta AI、xAI 及主要開源玩家皆無重大官方公告、產品上線或新模型發布。各大廠延續8月初安全與領導層調整後的安靜期。
